Bug_Title: Related "if/else if" statements should not have the same condition
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by having the same condition (param == 1) in two separate 'if/else if' statements. As a result, the second 'if' statement with the condition param == 1 is dead code and will never be executed.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case with input parameter as 1 triggers the bug as it should return 'Open window' but due to the bug in the code it returns 'Move window to the background' which makes the test case fail.
